Official Response from the Sovereign Republic of Velmara
Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Re: Proposed Resolution to the Conflict in Enkia
Date: June 25, 2025

The Sovereign Republic of Velmara expresses its grave concern over the recent military aggression against the sovereign nation of Enkia. Velmara has consistently opposed the unjustified invasion by Sikrisk and its allies, and we reiterate our unwavering commitment to international law, territorial integrity, and the rights of all nationslarge or smallto exist free from coercion or invasion.

We have reviewed the proposal put forward by The Free Land of Western View. Velmara acknowledges and appreciates the stated intention to end hostilities, halt participation in the aggression, and offer compensation for past actions. These are important steps toward restoring peace in the region.

However, Velmara firmly opposes any suggestion that Enkia should be required to "move the land" or make territorial concessions to appease aggressors. Such a precedent would undermine the fundamental principles of national sovereignty and reward unlawful military action.

Let it be clear:

Velmara supports the full restoration of Enkias territorial integrity.
We reject any territorial revisions resulting from military aggression.
We urge all parties to commit to a diplomatic process under international mediationpreferably through a neutral multilateral forum.
That said, we welcome the withdrawal of support for the invasion by Western View and commend the recognition of wrongdoing. Velmara would be willing to engage in multilateral talks to ensure long-term stability, investigate reparations fairly, and support efforts to hold accountable those responsible for any war crimes or violations of international law.

The road to peace must begin with the restoration of what was unlawfully takennot with the rewriting of borders to suit aggressors.

For Peace. For Sovereignty. For Enkia.

Signed,
Elira Vondan
Minister of Foreign Affairs
Sovereign Republic of Velmara

Speech by Supreme Chancellor Anika Rau
On the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with the Republic of Enkia
Office of the Supreme Chancellor, Solara

Broadcast live on national television and simulcast to Enkias national broadcaster
Fellow citizens of Velmara, and esteemed people of Enkia,

Today marks a turning point in the history of our two proud nations. In a time of increasing global uncertainty, where the sovereignty of smaller states is so often challenged, the Sovereign Republic of Velmara stands ready to extend a hand in friendshipand a shield in solidarity.

The government of Velmara, with the full support of our Parliament and people, recognizes the Republic of Enkia as a peaceful, independent, and sovereign nation. We admire your resilience, your dignity in the face of recent aggression, and your steadfast refusal to surrender to tyranny.

Let me be clear: Velmara will not stand idle while peace is threatened. The unprovoked invasion of Enkia by foreign powers is not just an attack on one nationit is a threat to the shared values of liberty, self-determination, and human dignity that bind us all.

Therefore, as Chancellor of Velmara, I make the following commitments:

We formally open diplomatic relations with the Republic of Enkia. Ambassadors will be exchanged within the coming weeks, and our embassies will serve as bridges of understanding, dialogue, and cooperation.
We pledge our defensive support. Should the Republic of Enkia come under further unprovoked attack, Velmara will respond with military assistance as necessary, in accordance with international law and our commitment to peace and justice.
We will offer humanitarian and logistical support. Our National Guard and Civil Service Corps stand ready to assist in rebuilding efforts, aid distribution, and medical services to support Enkias recovery.
We will call for restraint, dialogue, and international oversight to ensure that territorial integrity and national sovereignty are upheld across the region.
This is not a move toward escalation. It is a move toward equilibriuma firm stand for peace. We extend this offer not as conquerors, but as allies. Not to further war, but to prevent it.

Let this be the first chapter in a long, fruitful friendship between Velmara and Enkia. May we walk together as partners in a more just and secure world.

Thank you.

Glory to Velmara. Peace to Enkia.

[b]Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Baladullah [/b]

[u]Statement on the Aggression Against Enkia[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم [/i]

Baladullah condemns the aggression against Enkia in the strongest terms, and calls on the regional community to put an end to the war as soon as possible. Yes, it is true that Enkia might have a religion that we consider to be very misguided, but that alone isnt sufficient for any sort of invasion. 

Other than self defense, the only justification for war is to end a genocide or the brutal persecution of people based on their religion/ethnicity/race/sex etc. And in those instances, the war is to only be waged on a minimal basis and just to end the genocide and/or persecution. As far as we are aware, the government of Enkia isnt doing either of those things.

We are going to fully boycott the aggressing parties in this conflict until they agree to withdraw from Enkia. Such shameless aggression should not be tolerated.

[Nation]Sikirsk[/nation] and other aggressors

On behalf of the Sovereign Republic of Velmara, I address you not with pleasantries, but with the resolute voice of a nation that has witnessed enough.

Your continued and unjustified aggression toward the sovereign state of Enkia is a clear violation of international norms, regional stability, and the basic tenets of human decency. This war of choice, cloaked in false pretenses, has brought suffering not only to the Enkian people, but to the ideals we all claim to upholdself-determination, peace, and justice.

Velmara will not stand idle.

We call upon you, unequivocally and without delay, to:

Withdraw all armed forces from Enkian territory.
Commit to diplomatic resolution and reparations for the damage inflicted.
Cease all further acts of aggression.
Failure to do so will leave the Sovereign Republic of Velmara no choice but to invoke its sovereign right to defend regional peace. This includes, but is not limited to, mobilising military forces to assist Enkia in the protection of its borders, people, and democratic institutions.

This is not a threat. It is a promisea promise to uphold the dignity of nations, the security of our region, and the values upon which Velmara was built.

Choose peace. Stand down. History will judge your actions. So will we.

Anika Rau
Supreme Chancellor of the Sovereign Republic of Velmara
Solara, Velmara
